mapper.select: select psk_name from t_pos_skill where psk_position_id = #{positionId} and psk_required = 1 order by psk_id

select t.tal_id as talentId, t.tal_status as status, t.tal_resume_id as resumeId, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone from t_process_instance p join t_tal t on t.tal_process_instance_id = p.pin_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where p.pin_position_id = #{positionId} order by t.tal_id
select skl_name from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = (select tal_resume_id from t_tal where tal_id = #{talId}) order by skl_level desc, skl_id

select p.pin_position_id as taskId, pos.pos_title as positionName, count(distinct p.pin_id) as candidateCount, sum(case when t.tal_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as passedCount from t_process_instance p join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = p.pin_position_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_process_instance_id = p.pin_id group by p.pin_position_id, pos.pos_title order by p.pin_position_id desc

select t.tal_id as resultId, t.tal_matched_score as totalScore, t.tal_status as status, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, (select group_concat(skl_name separator ',') from t_res_skill s where s.skl_resume_id = t.tal_resume_id) as skills, (select group_concat(tg_name separator ',') from t_tal_tag g where g.tg_candidate_id = t.tal_id) as tags from t_process_instance p join t_tal t on t.tal_process_instance_id = p.pin_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where p.pin_position_id = #{positionId} order by t.tal_matched_score desc, t.tal_id

select cast(grt_match_points as char) as matchPoints, grt_content as content, grt_status as status, grt_sent_at as sentAt from t_greeting_record where grt_candidate_id = #{talId} order by grt_id desc limit 1
